exposure: ultrasound features of fetal ovarian cysts
original ultrasound examiner classification (simple vs. complex)
outcome: histological findings (necrosis, normal ovarian parenchyma, benign epithelial cyst)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 48 fetuses diagnosed with 51 fetal ovarian cysts via ultrasound examination at the Prenatal Diagnosis Division of the Bambino Gesu Children's Hospital.
finding: Applying IOTA terminology provided a more detailed and accurate description of fetal ovarian cysts, revealing that anechoic cysts and those with low-level content often resolve spontaneously, whereas cysts with ground-glass, hemorrhagic, mixed, or undefined content are frequently associated with necrosis after surgery.
